name: fivemesh
description: Local GTA V YDR/YFT/YTD preview pipeline with a .NET decoder, Express API, and React Three.js viewer.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/server && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: dotnet build apps/engine/Engine.csproj && npm run build --prefix apps/server && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/server && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run format:check
